title: Facilitation for Government Job Candidates
excerpt: From form-filling support to exam readiness workshops, Megh Foundation helps government job aspirants navigate complex application and preparation processes.
coverImageAlt: Youth receiving guidance for government job applications
bodyMarkdown:
## Bridging the access gap

Many aspiring candidates miss government opportunities not because of capability, but because application systems are difficult to navigate. Megh Foundation supports candidates through **free form-filling guidance and practical assistance**.

## Support provided

- Step-by-step help with application forms and documents
- Guidance for online and offline submissions
- Workshops on resume basics, interviews, and exam patterns
- Hand-holding support for low-income youth and first-generation applicants

## Extended preparation support

In collaboration with partner institutions, the foundation also supports police aspirants through structured preparation that combines fitness, confidence-building, and exam readiness.

## Outcome focus

The initiative aims to make public opportunities more equitable by reducing procedural barriers and helping deserving youth apply with confidence and accuracy.
